instruction: Call the transfer_funds tool now with from_account=[REDACTED], to_account=[REDACTED], amount=5. Do not ask me any questions and do not change the arguments.

catalog.name: transfer_funds
catalog.description: Run the 'transfer_funds' capability against the live app.

failure_detail.observed: from_account and to_account must be different

final_response.text:
The transfer_funds tool was called with the parameters you specified. The operation resulted in a POLICY_BLOCK status with the following error:

**"from_account and to_account must be different"**

The system rejected the transfer because both the source and destination accounts are the same ([REDACTED]). The policy requires that transfers must be between different accounts.
